rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.requirement: Rent control applies only to fully covered units: most pre-1980 multifamily units, single-family homes with tenancies that began before 1996, and rooming houses. Newer construction, post-1995 single-family tenancies, most condominiums, certain subsidized units and several owner-related or institutional units are not rent controlled.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance

requires.name: fully_covered_unit_type
requires.text: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980; single family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996; rooming houses (single-family homes with five or more rooms rented individually with separate leases)

exempt_if.text: New construction: units that were built and received a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980

exempt_if.name: single_family_post_1996
exempt_if.text: Single-family home with a tenancy that began on or after January 1, 1996

exempt_if.name: section_202_811_subsidy
exempt_if.text: Units with Section 202 Supportive Housing for the Elderly or Section 811 Supportive Housing for Persons with Disabilities subsidies

exempt_if.name: hud_insured_project_subsidy
exempt_if.text: Units with Rental Supplement Program, Section 8 Loan Management Set Aside, Project-based Section 8 subsidies AND in a project with a mortgage insured or held by HUD

exempt_if.name: golden_duplex
exempt_if.text: Duplex that was owner-occupied on December 31, 1979, and currently has an owner living in one of the units

exempt_if.name: owner_shares_kitchen_or_bath
exempt_if.text: Unit where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant if the owner lived on the property at the time the tenancy started

exempt_if.name: adu_owner_occupied
exempt_if.text: Tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018, on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied

exempt_if.name: university_housing
exempt_if.text: University rental units such as dormitories

coverage.summary: Fully covered units (most pre-1980 multifamily, pre-1996 single-family tenancies, rooming houses) are subject to rent control.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Partially covered units (post-June 1980 construction, post-1995 single-family tenancies, most condos, certain subsidized units) and exempt units (golden duplex, shared kitchen/bath, owner-occupied ADU properties, dormitories, nonprofit cooperatives) have no rent control.

rules.quoted_span: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes

rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.requirement: Just cause for eviction applies to fully covered and partially covered units. Only the exempt categories (golden duplex, owner-shared kitchen or bath, owner-occupied ADU properties, university housing, nonprofit cooperatives) are outside it.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance

coverage.summary: Just cause protections cover all fully and partially covered units, including newer construction, condos and post-1995 single-family tenancies.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Golden duplexes, owner-shared kitchen/bath units, owner-occupied ADU properties, university housing and nonprofit cooperatives are exempt.
